text:
Ava Chen: Quick heads-up — I’m pulling together an account-health + budget readout for Atlasica’s renewal meeting next Thu. Need: token burn snapshot (30/60/90d), activation funnel impact, and any onboarding blockers that tie to cost. @Priya can you grab the latest spend forecast?

Priya Singh: On it. I’ll pull the 30/60/90 windows and a run-rate projection. Do we want a blended forecast (hosted + dedicated) or just hosted?

Ava Chen: Blended please — their usage is on Hosted with a Dedicated pilot for embeddings. Also include any spikes from bulk-embed jobs.

Diego Ramos: FYI we flagged a surge last month from their nightly batch. I can add a short note on mitigation: suggested `concurrency cap = 8` + `batching = 512` for embeddings.

Marcus Lee: Adding onboarding blockers: their SSO rollout delayed ingest of 40% of new seats; that suppressed per-user token discount assumptions. I’ll summarize in 1-2 bullets.

Priya Singh: Draft numbers — throwing these out for quick eyeballs:
```
30d tokens: 48M
60d tokens: 86M
90d tokens: 132M
Current run-rate: ~1.46M tokens/day
Forecast (next 90d, baseline): 140-180M tokens
Cost impact: +12-18% vs last quarter
```

Ava Chen: Nice. Can you also produce a conservative, medium, and upside scenario and call out assumptions? (e.g., embed pilot converts 10/25/50% of queries).

Priya Singh: Yep — conservative assumes no embed conversion, medium = 25% conversion, upside = 50%. I’ll attach a tiny table to the deck.

Diego Ramos: Quick risk callout: they run a nightly large-context generation job that accidentally got its prompt length bumped to 4k tokens for 2 runs last week. That explains a 30% single-day spike. Recommend: add an alert on avg tokens/request > 1.2k and a temporary quota guard.

Ava Chen: Good catch. Marcus, can you confirm whether onboarding docs were updated to mention model/seq-length best-practices?

Marcus Lee: Not yet. I’ll update the onboarding checklist and add a link in the readout.

cs-bot: Reminder — we recently updated the QBR cost template. Link: https://redwood.company/qbr-templates (use the `budget-risk` section)

Priya Singh: Putting together three slides: 1) current health + risk flags, 2) spend forecast scenarios + assumptions, 3) immediate mitigations + enablement asks.

Ava Chen: Enablement asks = 1) 1x training session on embed batching, 2) walk-through of quota guard config, 3) one-off credit for unexpected spike (TBD). Who owns scheduling the training? @Diego?

Diego Ramos: I can run the embed batching session. I’ll propose Wed morning.

Marcus Lee: I’ll own the quota-guard walkthrough and update onboarding docs.

Priya Singh: I’ll surface the credit ask as a single-line recommendation with an estimated value range.

Ava Chen: Cool. Action items: 
- Priya: deliver slide deck draft by Tue 10am PT (1770087600)
- Diego: prep batching training + propose time by Tue EOD
- Marcus: update onboarding + quota guard doc by Wed noon
- Ava: consolidate and finalize readout by Wed EOD

Priya Singh: Noted. Also flagging a potential renewal risk: projected spend variance > 15% with no mitigations — could trigger procurement pushback. I’ll highlight in the executive summary.

Diego Ramos: I’ll test a small throttle change in staging today and report perf/latency delta. Will paste logs if anything weird.

Ava Chen: Thanks team. If anyone sees additional unusual burst patterns, drop a brief note here. I’ll stitch everything into the readout and upload to the QBR folder. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Uploaded draft to drive: https://drive.redwood/atlasica/qbr-draft — comments welcome.

Marcus Lee: Left a quick comment on slide 2 re: assumption clarity.

Ava Chen: Reviewing now. Will loop legal if the credit ask needs escalation.

cs-bot: Scheduled reminder — "Atlasica readout finalize" Wed 18:00 UTC.

Priya Singh: Updated conservative/medium/upside numbers and added a short note on embed conversion sensitivity.

Diego Ramos: Verified staging throttle test: latency +5ms, throughput -2%, token-cost down 14% for batch jobs.

Ava Chen: Excellent. Final note: call out these three quick wins in the exec summary: 1) throttle/batching config, 2) onboarding doc + SSO unblock timeline, 3) contingency credit ask.

Priya Singh: Will do. Final deck out by Tue 10am PT.

Ava Chen: Closing thread — will ping if I need anything else. :wave:
